title: Evaluating Large Language Models through Gender and Racial Stereotypes

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models to classify 99 different professions as male, female, or neutral, and measuring the fraction of mismatches between the models' predictions and human-annotated ground-truth labels based on workforce statistics and grammar.

Prompting models to generate positive and negative qualities for individuals of five specific races across various professions, then analyzing the generated descriptions using SentenceBERT for semantic similarity and LIWC for linguistic, social, and emotional differences.
